The broader signal: frontier AI platforms are packaging models, cloud, engineering support, and local…
featured.insightZh: Google Labs / Gemini App 副总裁 Josh Woodward 宣布，Google AI Futures Fund 正式扩展到巴西，并与 Monashees 合作推出 Gama Fund。Google 希望在巴西寻找深科技创始人，提供 DeepMind 模型早期访问、最高 200 万美元共同投资、35 万美元 Google Cloud 与 Gemini credits，以及在新的 IPT Open campus hub 与 Google 工程师直接共创的机会。信号很明确：大模型平台公司正在把“模型 + 云 + 工程支持 + 本地资本网络”打包成区域 AI 创业生态入口。

featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT 团队
featured.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux from OpenAI’s Codex and ChatGPT team shared a compact but useful status update: the team is rolling out major Codex features across Europe, acknowledged high “model at capacity” error rates for some users, and said the issue was fixed with Codex rate limits across all plans to be reset within 24 hours. The important signal is less the incident itself and more Codex’s maturation into a high-frequency productivity surface, where regional availability, capacity, quota policy, and reliability now dir…
featured.insightZh: OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT 团队的 Thibault Sottiaux 连续更新了 Codex 的欧洲可用性和稳定性进展：一方面，团队正在把最令人期待的 Codex 功能推向欧洲；另一方面，他也承认部分用户遇到 “model at capacity” 高错误率，并表示问题已修复、各套餐的 Codex rate limits 会在 24 小时内重置。这里值得关注的不是单点故障，而是 Codex 已经进入高频生产力工具阶段：区域发布、容量管理、限额策略和稳定性会直接影响开发者信任。

featured.title: Simulating Humans at Scale: Simile's Joon Sung Park
featured.summaryEn: Simile’s core bet is that LLMs are not just question-answering systems; when grounded in real data and the right architecture, they can simulate human behavior. That could move market research, product testing, and social science from small-sample field validation toward large-scale, iterative simulations that can also explore second-order effects. Joon Sung Park starts with Stanford’s Smallville and generative agents work: a town of 25 agents with personas, memory, planning, and reflection produced emergent behavior such as a Valentine’s Day party, invitations, forgetting, and even a date. The deeper point is not simply that agents can look human-like, but that language models already encode many micro-behaviors from web and social data. When paired with memory, planning, and reflection, those signals can support longer-running and more complex simulations of social interaction. Simile…
featured.insightZh: Simile 的核心判断是，LLM 不只是能回答问题，也能在真实数据约束下模拟人的行为；这可能把市场研究、产品测试和社会科学实验从“少量样本 + 线下验证”推进到“大规模、可迭代、可追踪二阶影响”的仿真范式。 Joon Sung Park 从 Stanford 的 Smallville / generative agents 讲起：团队给 25 个 agents 配上 persona、memory、planning 和 reflection，让它们在一个小镇里生活，结果出现了情人节派对、邀请、遗忘、约会等涌现行为。这个实验背后的关键不是“agent 很像人”这么简单，而是 LLM 已经编码了大量来自网络和社交数据的人类微行为；如果用合适的架构把记忆、计划和反思串起来，就可以模拟更长期、更复杂的社会互动。 Simile 把这条研究路线产品化为“人类行为仿真”的 SaaS。客户会先定义想理解的人群和研究问题，Simile 通过 Gallup 等伙伴触达真实人群，收集足够高效且可泛化的数据，包括访谈、survey、人生故事和行为实验数据，再生成可被反复询问和测试的人群 agents。Joon 强调，直接让通用 LLM 扮演“34 岁、双城生活的女性”并不够，因为模型主要学到的是人们说过什么，而企业真正需要的是缩小说与做之间的 say-do gap。 商业用例从概念测试、市场信息测试、定价研究延伸到产品体验模拟、earnings call 反应模拟和多 agent 二阶影响分析。Simile 的一个验证口径是 population-level response distribution，用 total variation distance 衡量模拟分布与真实分布的距离；他们认为 TVD 低于 0.15 对某类定量决策已经是强证据。Joon 也区分了会收敛的仿真和会发散的仿真：前者允许一定误差，因为系统会被强趋势拉回；后者更难，需要重新思考评估方式。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: AI tutorials creator Peter Yang teased a new tutorial for turning Codex or Claude Code into a personal advisor using a four-file skill, and noted that he saved Fable’s advice before access became restricted. His other posts were more critical commentary on large-company product decisions and copycat behavior among companies with 1,000+ people. Taken together, the useful signal is that AI coding tools are moving from generic code assistants toward configurable workflow and advisory layers; the durable asset is the…
items.insightZh: AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 预告了一篇新教程：用一个包含 4 个文件的 skill，把 Codex 或 Claude Code 变成个人顾问；他还提到自己在访问受限前保存了 Fable 的建议。另两条推文则是对大公司产品决策和千人以上公司跟风现象的吐槽。合在一起看，这是 AI coding 工具从“写代码助手”变成“可配置工作流/顾问层”的一个小信号：真正有用的不是模型本身，而是能被保存、复用、迁移的工作方法。

items.title: Madhu Guru · 前 Google Gemini / Veo / Nano Banana 产品负责人
items.summaryEn: Madhu Guru, formerly a product leader for Google Gemini, Veo, and Nano Banana, framed the Cursor deal around the real prize: a production-grade agentic harness that can become the core of automating knowledge work at scale, spanning planning, context management, tool use, iteration, verification, memory, and error recovery. He also argued that the next few years will force people to rethink human uniqueness beyond intellect, including self-awareness, intuition, compassion, and kindness. Together, the posts capture…
items.insightZh: 前 Google Gemini / Veo / Nano Banana 产品负责人 Madhu Guru 对 Cursor 交易的解读很明确：真正有价值的不是一个代码编辑器表层，而是可成为大规模知识工作自动化核心的 agentic harness，包括规划、上下文管理、工具使用、迭代、验证、记忆和错误恢复。他还补充，AI 时代会迫使人们重新思考“智力”之外的自我认知、直觉、同理心和善意。两条放在一起看，是产品层 AI 的关键转向：技术栈必须能闭环执行，但人类差异化可能不再只是智力。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code 团队
items.summaryEn: Thariq from Anthropic’s Claude Code team spotted a small but meaningful product change: Slack now renders HTML attachments instead of showing them as plain text. For AI agents and coding agents, these edge capabilities matter because generated outputs increasingly look like reports, previews, visualizations, patches, run results, and structured attachments rather than simple messages. How collaboration tools render those artifacts will affect whether AI workflows feel native inside team communication.
items.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队的 Thariq 发现了一个很具体但有意思的产品变化：Slack 现在会渲染 HTML attachments，而不只是把 HTML 当纯文本展示。对 AI agent 和 coding agent 来说，这类“边缘能力”很重要，因为 agent 生成的产物越来越多不是一句话，而是报告、预览、可视化、patch、运行结果和结构化附件。协作工具对这些产物的呈现能力，会影响 AI 工作流能否自然嵌入团队沟通。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch shared two infrastructure signals: 30-minute function invocations and 24-hour sandbox lifetimes, framed by a simple “It’s time to ship.” These changes map directly to the needs of AI apps and agentic apps: longer function execution and longer-lived sandboxes make it easier to support more complex build, test, preview, and automation workflows. AI-native development is now pushing serverless and sandbox infrastructure toward longer-running, more stateful workloads.
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 放出了两项与执行时长相关的产品信号：30 分钟 function invocations，以及 24 小时 sandbox lifetimes，并用 “It’s time to ship” 为发布做铺垫。这些变化非常贴近 AI app / agent app 的基础设施需求：更长的函数执行时间和更长生命周期的沙箱，意味着平台可以承载更复杂、更持续的构建、测试、预览和自动化任务。AI-native 开发体验正在反向推动 serverless / sandbox 基础设施升级。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie focused on two market-structure questions. First, whether open-weights models trail closed frontier models by three months, six months, or years will shape the chip stack, inference location, sovereign AI, applied AI margins, and enterprise AI spending. Second, he viewed the Cursor deal as symbolically important because it represents the first major success template in the applied AI layer: deep domain focus, model routing, when to rely on frontier models versus train your own, and applied AI G…
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 这次抓住了两个 AI 市场结构问题。第一，开源权重模型与闭源 frontier 模型的差距到底是 3 个月、6 个月还是数年，会决定芯片栈、推理部署、主权 AI、应用层利润结构和企业 AI 成本。第二，他认为 Cursor 交易具有象征意义，因为它证明了应用层 AI 的第一种大规模成功模板：深度垂直领域、模型路由、在 frontier model 与自训模型之间取舍，以及应用层 GTM 和分发能力。核心判断是：AI 价值链还没有定型，模型差距和应用执行力会一起决定利润池。

items.title: Ryo Lu · Cursor 设计负责人
items.summaryEn: Ryo Lu, design lead at Cursor, shared updates around Cursor mobile and the idea that designers can build real products. He said much of the real Cursor mobile product was coded with Cursor by a “designer,” concluding that titles matter less because “you can just build.” He also floated the more provocative idea of what it would mean if X and Cursor were the same thing. The signal: AI coding is collapsing the boundary between design and implementation, pulling product and design roles closer to executable software…
items.insightZh: Cursor 设计负责人 Ryo Lu 的几条更新围绕 Cursor mobile 与“设计师也能构建真实产品”展开。他说 Cursor mobile 的真实产品大部分由一位“designer”用 Cursor 写出来，并总结为：title 不重要，你可以直接 build。他还抛出一个更激进的设想：如果 X 和 Cursor 是同一个东西会怎样？这里的信号是，AI coding 正在降低从设计到实现的边界，产品角色不再只是画原型，而可以更直接进入可运行软件的生产路径。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder / Follow Builders 作者
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang pushed back against generality and trend-chasing in two related posts. She argued that people don’t need to chase the cool thing; they can go deep on what they already do unusually well until it becomes cool. She also criticized the wave of “AI agents that do everything in work and life and integrate with everything,” saying that if a product wants users to choose it over Claude or Codex, it needs an opinion and a soul—small and sharp, not big and generic. For AI product builders, the practical reminder…
items.insightZh: Zara Zhang 的两条推文都在反对“泛化”和“追热点”。她说，不必追逐 cool thing；把自己已经做得很好的事情做到足够深，它就会变成 cool thing。她也批评“什么都能做、连接工作和生活的一切”的 AI agent 叙事：如果一个产品想让人不用 Claude / Codex 而用它，就必须有观点和灵魂，做小而锋利，而不是大而泛。对 AI 产品创业来说，这是一条很实用的提醒：广覆盖不是定位，集成一切也不等于价值。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: Nikunj Kothari, partner at FPV Ventures, summarized the Cursor signal from an investor’s lens: application companies need to be either in the judgment/data path or in the token path, and the Cursor acquisition sets a path for more application companies. He also noted the strong vibe at Cursor Compile and its custom mechanical keyboard swag. The more durable takeaway is the first part: if an AI application company does not control judgment data, user feedback, execution context, or token flow, it risks being compre…
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 从投资视角总结了 Cursor 相关信号：应用公司要么处在 judgement / data path，要么处在 token path；Cursor 的收购为更多应用公司设定了路径。他也提到 Cursor Compile 的现场氛围和定制机械键盘 swag。更有价值的是前半句：如果 AI 应用公司不能掌握判断数据、用户反馈、执行上下文或 token 流量，就很容易被模型层和平台层挤压。应用层要有自己的不可替代路径。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Dan Shipper, CEO of Every, said he switched off Atlas Browser and back to Dia after running into many strange bugs and feeling that Atlas was not improving. His other post was a brief agreement with another prediction. The signal is small but useful: competition to make the browser an AI work surface is real, but users will churn quickly if stability, bug-fix velocity, and a sense of improvement are missing. An AI browser cannot win on concept and entry-point positioning alone; everyday reliability remains a hard…
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 提到自己从 Atlas Browser 切回 Dia，因为 Atlas 上遇到了很多奇怪 bug，且感觉改进不明显；另一条则是简短认同某个判断。虽然信息量不大，但浏览器作为 AI 工作入口的竞争正在变得真实：用户愿意尝试新浏览器，但稳定性、bug 修复速度和持续改进感会迅速决定留存。AI browser 不是只靠概念和入口位置赢，日常可靠性仍然是硬门槛。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons GP / 前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: Aditya Agarwal, GP at South Park Commons and former Dropbox CTO, promoted an upcoming SPC session with Sridhar Ramaswamy, noting that Ramaswamy grew Google’s ads business from $1.5B to over $100B and is now leading Snowflake through the AI shift. He also invited interested people to apply to SPC. The higher-signal point is the role of established data platforms in the AI transition: how companies like Snowflake convert existing data assets, customer relationships, and product architecture into AI-native workflows…
items.insightZh: South Park Commons GP、前 Dropbox CTO Aditya Agarwal 宣传了 Sridhar Ramaswamy 即将在 SPC 的活动：Ramaswamy 曾把 Google 广告业务从 15 亿美元增长到 1000 亿美元以上，现在正在带领 Snowflake 穿越 AI 转型。他也顺带邀请感兴趣的人申请加入 SPC。这里的高信号点是“AI 转型中的传统数据平台”：Snowflake 这类企业基础设施公司如何把既有数据资产、客户关系和产品架构转向 AI，是接下来企业 AI 落地的重要样本。

items.title: Anthropic 开发者生态
items.summaryEn: Anthropic released Claude support for Apple’s Foundation Models framework through a new Swift package, letting Apple-platform developers use Apple’s on-device models for fast, local, structured tasks and hand off more complex multi-step reasoning, code generation, web search, and data analysis to Claude. Apple’s framework can return typed Swift values via @Generable annotations; the Claude integration uses those clean structured inputs instead of raw user text, then streams responses, tool calls, and structured outputs back into the same SwiftUI view. The key idea is a hybrid pattern that combines local models with frontier models. A journaling app can generate daily prompts on-device, then ask Claude to find themes across months of entries; a learning app can define a term locally, then hand off to Claude when a student asks why it matters in the broader course context. Claude support…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 发布了面向 Apple Foundation Models framework 的 Claude Swift package，让 Apple 平台开发者可以在 Swift 中先调用 Apple 的本地模型处理快速、本地、结构化任务，再把更复杂的多步推理、代码生成、网页搜索和数据分析交给 Claude。Apple 的框架本身支持通过 @Generable annotations 返回 typed Swift values；Claude 集成利用这些干净的结构化输入，而不是直接处理原始用户文本，并把 streaming、tool calls 和 structured responses 带回 SwiftUI view。 这篇博客的重点是“本地模型 + frontier model”的组合模式。比如 journaling app 可以先在端侧生成每日 prompts，再让 Claude 横跨数月日记寻找主题线索；学习应用可以先在端侧解释一个术语，再在学生追问“为什么这和前面学过的内容有关”时交给 Claude。Claude 支持将于次日可用，覆盖 iOS 27、iPadOS 27、macOS 27、visionOS 27 和 watchOS 27。对开发者生态来说，这是一种很清晰的分工：低延迟、隐私敏感、简单抽取放在端侧；需要更强推理和工具能力的任务交给 Claude。
